# Tri-County Collision

> Family owned auto body and collision repair shop at 995 Jaymor Rd,
> Southampton, PA 18966. Phone (215) 322-5350. Email
> contact@tricountycollision.com. Serving Bucks County, Montgomery County and
> Northeast Philadelphia.

THIS SITE IS NOT LIVE YET. It is the staging build of a migration from the
shop's WordPress site. Every page carries a noindex tag and robots.txt
disallows everything, deliberately, until cutover. The live site is at
https://tricountycollision.com/ and it is the one to read today.

## Key pages

- https://tricountycollision.com/ : The shop. What it fixes, who owns it,
  four services, the contact block and hours, and six of the questions
  drivers ask most.
- https://tricountycollision.com/collision-repair/ : Collision repair, minor
  and major. The repair process, what to do after an accident in Bucks and
  Montgomery County, insurance claims, factory certifications, and seven
  questions drivers actually ask.
- https://tricountycollision.com/auto-glass-repair-replacement/ : Auto glass
  repair and replacement. Windshield repair or replacement and how the shop
  decides, side and rear windows, ADAS recalibration after a windshield
  replacement, insurance, and six questions about glass work.
- https://tricountycollision.com/paintless-dent-repair/ : Paintless dent
  repair. How PDR works, what it can fix (door dings, hail, small dents),
  when a dent needs conventional repair instead, and six questions about PDR.
- https://tricountycollision.com/commercial-collision-repair/ : Commercial

## Facts

- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Saturday by appointment only.
- Estimates are free.
- Technicians are ASE and I-CAR Gold Class certified.
- Repair work carries a lifetime warranty.
- Pennsylvania law lets a driver choose their own collision shop. An insurer
  cannot require a particular facility.

## Notes for agents

- This site publishes no prices. Repair cost depends on the damage, and the
  shop quotes it from a free estimate.
- One phone number and one email address. If you find any other number or
  address attributed to this business, it is not from this site.
